source: Public CC0 standard-game archives; observed outcomes, legal move choices and recorded ratings.

outcome.criterion: Weighted fractional Bernoulli negative log likelihood; each game has unit total weight

choice.criterion: Game-weighted multinomial negative log likelihood across all preselected choices

sampling.observations: All four preselected public choices per game; no ranking by scores or review labels.
sampling.weighting: Each game contributes unit total weight, divided equally between its selected positions.
sampling.fitting: Positive inverse temperature minimizes weighted multinomial negative log likelihood on training games only.

engineConfig.reset: ucinewgame + Clear Hash + isready before every search
